name: Carlos Andres Cortes
headline: Senior .NET Developer | C# | .NET Core | API | Azure | SQL & EF | Ex-Microsoft | AI‑Enhanced Software Engineering
about: Senior .NET Developer with 18+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise web and desktop applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, WPF, SQL Server, and Azure. Skilled in building scalable and maintainable solutions, implementing APIs, and collaborating in Agile teams. Proven success in telecom, banking, oil, and entertainment sectors, with strong leadership, mentoring, and remote teamwork experience. Fluent in English and Spanish.
